messages:
maria: Heads-up — nightshift deploy scheduled in 30m. Planning runtime bump to v2.3.1 and pin redwood/model-serve:1.4.0 for EU dedicated. Window 02:00–03:00 UTC. Need a short statuspage snippet + customer notify draft.
kevin: ack. rollback criteria? propose: 5xx > 1% sustained for 10m OR P99 latency > 2s for 5m. start a 5% canary for 15m first.
lina: can we scope the pin to EU only? that avoids global churn.
support: yep — drafting customer blurb now, will keep it short.
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] runtime-v2.3.1 -> pool: eu-dedicated. canary: 5% -> start at 02:00 UTC.
support: STATUSPAGE SNIPPET DRAFT:
```
We will perform a routine runtime update for EU Dedicated customers on 2026-03-21 02:00–03:00 UTC. Some requests may experience brief latency increases; reserved capacity customers should not see downtime. No config changes required. We will monitor closely and will roll back if error rates exceed 1% or latency regressions persist.
Updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```
maria: good — add the "no config changes required" line (support added it). Keep it customer-friendly. :thumbsup:
sam: ops checklist note: have rollback image ready — redwood/model-serve:1.3.9@sha256:abc123. Watch KV cache hit rate and prefix cache evictions during canary.
kevin: decision: start canary at 02:00, observe metrics 15m. If OK, ramp to 50% then to 100% over 30m. If hit rollback criteria, rollback to 1.3.9 and file an incident.
lina: I'll prepare the statuspage post and hold until canary green. Who takes customer email if needed? @support?
support: I'll handle customer emails if >5% customers affected or degradation lasts >10min. Otherwise we'll just post a status update.
deploy-bot: canary started at 02:00 UTC. telemetry snapshot — 5xx: 0.2%, P99: 590ms, error budget used: 0.02%.
maria: looks good so far. keep this channel live, ping me on any regressions. tagging @kevin @lina @support
support: copied. Statuspage ready to publish at 02:05 UTC once canary passes. Draft email ready in #support-drafts.
deploy-bot: ramp: 50% at 02:20 UTC. telemetry: 5xx: 0.25%, P99: 610ms.
sam: monitoring KV metrics — small bump then stable. no manual interventions.
kevin: still green. continue final ramp to 100% over next 25m.
deploy-bot: rollout complete at 02:45 UTC. pin persisted: runtime-v2.3.1 pinned for eu-dedicated. no rollback performed.
maria: closing loop — thanks team. Support, please post final status update and keep the customer email queued if we see post-deploy issues. I'll publish a short release note in product tomorrow. :tada:
